subject: Quote & Logo Release for GCP Marketplace Listing

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-12 09:17 -0700
Subject: Request: short customer quote + logo release for GCP Marketplace listing

Hi Jordan,

Hope you're doing well — quick one from our marketplace team. We're preparing the GCP Marketplace listing for Redwood on the co-sell track and would love to include a 1-2 sentence quote from QuantifyAI about the value you're seeing (e.g., performance/cost improvements, developer velocity, reliability). Example: "Redwood Inference reduced our inference latency by 60% and simplified deployment across environments." Feel free to use that as a starting point.

Could you also confirm permission to use the QuantifyAI logo and a short blurb on the Marketplace listing? If it's easier, we can send a DocuSign logo release for signature. Attached is a short guidance doc (testimonial_guidance.pdf) with tone/length suggestions and a sample logo release.

Would appreciate a thumbs-up or an edited line by EOD Friday so we can meet GCP's co-sell materials deadline.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
(415) 555-0189

Thanks for the note. Happy to help — here are two quick options:

1) "Redwood Inference cut our inference costs by nearly half and made it straightforward to move models from dev to production."
2) "With Redwood we saw a 60% latency improvement and consistent throughput across our cloud and on-prem deployments."

Either of those work for us — prefer option 2. We can grant logo use; I'll route the logo release to our legal team for a quick review. Attaching our official signature block (QuantifyAI_SignatureBlock.png).

If you need the signed release, I'll ask legal to sign the DocuSign now and send back.
